    finished_html = None
    macros = {}
    shutdown_event = None
    deck_dir = None
    resource_dir = None
    
    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        pass
    
    def send_bytes(self, data, ctype, cache=False):
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', ctype)
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(data)))
        if cache:
            self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'public, max-age=604800, immutable')
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)
    
    def do_GET(self):
        path = urlparse(self.path).path
        
        if path == '/':
            if DrillHandler.finished_html:
                html = DrillHandler.finished_html
            elif DrillHandler.state:
                if DrillHandler.state.is_done():
                    html = '<html><body>Queue empty.</body></html>'
                else:
                    html = render_drill_page(DrillHandler.state) or '<html><body>Error</body></html>'
            else:
                html = '<html><body>No session.</body></html>'
            self.send_bytes(html.encode('utf-8'), 'text/html; charset=utf-8')
        
        elif path == '/style.css':
            data = open(os.path.join(DrillHandler.resource_dir, 'style.css'), 'rb').read()
            self.send_bytes(data, 'text/css', cache=True)
        
        elif path == '/script.js':
            base = open(os.path.join(DrillHandler.resource_dir, 'script_base.js'), 'r').read()
            macro_lines = 'let MACROS = {};\n'
            for k, v in DrillHandler.macros.items():
                v_esc = v.replace('\\', '\\\\').replace("'", "\\'")
                macro_lines += f"MACROS['{k}'] = '{v_esc}';\n"
            script = macro_lines + '\n' + base
            self.send_bytes(script.encode('utf-8'), 'text/javascript')
        
        elif path == '/katex/katex.css':
            data = open(os.path.join(DrillHandler.resource_dir, 'katex.css'), 'rb').read()
            self.send_bytes(data, 'text/css', cache=True)
        
        elif path == '/katex/katex.js':
            data = open(os.path.join(DrillHandler.resource_dir, 'katex.js'), 'rb').read()
            self.send_bytes(data, 'text/javascript', cache=True)
        
        elif path == '/katex/mhchem.js':
            data = open(os.path.join(DrillHandler.resource_dir, 'mhchem.js'), 'rb').read()
            self.send_bytes(data, 'text/javascript', cache=True)
        
        elif path.startswith('/katex/fonts/'):
            fname = os.path.basename(path)
            fpath = os.path.join(DrillHandler.resource_dir, 'fonts', fname)
            if os.path.exists(fpath):
                data = open(fpath, 'rb').read()
                ext = os.path.splitext(fname)[1].lower()
                ct = {'woff2': 'font/woff2', 'woff': 'font/woff', 'ttf': 'font/truetype'}.get(ext[1:], 'application/octet-stream')
                self.send_bytes(data, ct, cache=True)
            else:
                self.send_error(404)
        
        elif path.startswith('/file/'):
            fname = path[6:]
            fpath = os.path.join(DrillHandler.deck_dir, fname)
            if os.path.exists(fpath):
                data = open(fpath, 'rb').read()
                ext = os.path.splitext(fname)[1].lower()
                ct_map = {
                    '.mp3': 'audio/mpeg', '.ogg': 'audio/ogg', '.wav': 'audio/wav',
                    '.mp4': 'video/mp4', '.webm': 'video/webm',
                    '.jpg': 'image/jpeg', '.jpeg': 'image/jpeg',
                    '.png': 'image/png', '.gif': 'image/gif',
                    '.webp': 'image/webp', '.svg': 'image/svg+xml',
                }
                ct = ct_map.get(ext, 'application/octet-stream')
                self.send_bytes(data, ct)
            else:
                self.send_error(404)
        else:
            self.send_error(404)
    
    def do_POST(self):
        ct = self.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
        if 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' not in ct:
            self.send_response(415)
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(b'Form requests must have `Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded`')
            return
        
        length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', 0))
        body = self.rfile.read(length).decode('utf-8')
        params = parse_qs(body)
        action = params.get('action', [''])[0]
        
        state = DrillHandler.state
        
        if action == 'Reveal' and state and not state.ended:
            state.reveal()
        elif action in ('Forgot', 'Hard', 'Good', 'Easy') and state and not state.ended:
            state.grade_card(action.lower())
        elif action == 'Undo' and state and not state.ended:
            state.undo()
        elif action == 'End':
            if state and not state.ended:
                _, started_at, ended_at = state.end_session()
                DrillHandler.finished_html = render_finished_page(state, started_at, ended_at)
                DrillHandler.state = None
        elif action == 'Shutdown':
            if DrillHandler.shutdown_event:
                DrillHandler.shutdown_event.set()
            self.send_response(303)
            self.send_header('Location', '/')
            self.send_header('Content-Length', '0')
            self.end_headers()
            return
        
        self.send_response(303)
        self.send_header('Location', '/')
        self.send_header('Content-Length', '0')
        self.end_headers()

def cmd_drill(directory, host='127.0.0.1', port=8000, card_limit=None,
              new_card_limit=None, from_deck=None, open_browser=True,
              answer_controls='full', bury_siblings=True):
    conn = init_db(directory)
    all_cards = collect_cards(directory)
    
    if from_deck:
        all_cards = [c for c in all_cards if c['deckName'] == from_deck]
    
    sync_cards_to_db(conn, all_cards)
    card_map = {c['hash']: c for c in all_cards}
    
    today = date.today().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    # New cards
    cursor.execute('''SELECT card_hash FROM cards WHERE review_count = 0 ORDER BY added_at''')
    new_hashes = [r[0] for r in cursor.fetchall() if r[0] in card_map]
    
    # Due cards
    cursor.execute('''SELECT card_hash FROM cards WHERE review_count > 0 AND due_date <= ? ORDER BY due_date ASC''',
                  (today,))
    due_hashes = [r[0] for r in cursor.fetchall() if r[0] in card_map]
    
    if new_card_limit is not None:
        new_hashes = new_hashes[:new_card_limit]
    
    all_due = due_hashes + new_hashes
    
    if card_limit is not None:
        all_due = all_due[:card_limit]
    
    macros = collect_macros(directory)
    
    # Set up handler class state
    DrillHandler.state = DrillState(all_due, card_map, conn,
                                     answer_controls=answer_controls,
                                     bury_siblings=bury_siblings)
    DrillHandler.finished_html = None
    DrillHandler.macros = macros
    DrillHandler.deck_dir = directory
    DrillHandler.resource_dir = _RESOURCE_DIR
    
    shutdown_event = threading.Event()
    DrillHandler.shutdown_event = shutdown_event
    
    httpd = HTTPServer((host, port), DrillHandler)
    
    def serve():
        while not shutdown_event.is_set():
            httpd.handle_request()
        httpd.server_close()
    
    t = threading.Thread(target=serve, daemon=True)
    t.start()
    
    print(f"Serving on http://{host}:{port}/")
    
    if open_browser:
        threading.Timer(0.5, lambda: webbrowser.open(f'http://{host}:{port}/')).start()
    
    shutdown_event.wait()
    conn.close()

    deck_name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(file_path))[0]
    cards = []
    lines = content.split('\n')
    n = len(lines)
    i = 0
    
    while i < n:
        line = lines[i]
        
        if line.startswith('Q:'):
            line_start = i
            question_parts = [line[2:].strip()]
            i += 1
            
            while i < n and not lines[i].startswith('A:'):
                question_parts.append(lines[i])
                i += 1
            
            while question_parts and question_parts[-1].strip() == '':
                question_parts.pop()
            question = '\n'.join(question_parts)
            
            if i < n and lines[i].startswith('A:'):
                answer_first = lines[i][2:].strip()
                i += 1
                answer_parts = []
                
                if answer_first:
                    answer_parts = [answer_first]
                    while i < n and lines[i].strip() != '' and not lines[i].startswith('Q:') and not lines[i].startswith('C:'):
                        answer_parts.append(lines[i])
                        i += 1
                else:
                    while i < n and lines[i].strip() == '':
                        i += 1
                    while i < n and lines[i].strip() != '' and not lines[i].startswith('Q:') and not lines[i].startswith('C:'):
                        answer_parts.append(lines[i])
                        i += 1
                
                while answer_parts and answer_parts[-1].strip() == '':
                    answer_parts.pop()
                answer = '\n'.join(answer_parts)
                line_end = i - 1
                
                while i < n and lines[i].strip() == '':
                    i += 1
                
                content_obj = {'basic': {'question': question, 'answer': answer}}
                cards.append({
                    'hash': compute_card_hash(content_obj),
                    'familyHash': None,
                    'deckName': deck_name,
                    'location': {
                        'filePath': os.path.abspath(file_path),
                        'lineStart': line_start,
                        'lineEnd': line_end
                    },
                    'content': content_obj,
                    'performance': None
                })
        
        elif line.startswith('C:'):
            line_start = i
            first_line = line[2:].strip()
            cloze_parts = []
            
            if first_line:
                cloze_parts = [first_line]
                i += 1
                while i < n:
                    cur = lines[i]
                    if cur.startswith('Q:') or cur.startswith('C:'):
                        break
                    if cur.strip() == '':
                        j = i + 1
                        while j < n and lines[j].strip() == '':
                            j += 1
                        if j >= n or lines[j].startswith('Q:') or lines[j].startswith('C:'):
                            break
                    cloze_parts.append(cur)
                    i += 1
            else:
                i += 1
                while i < n and lines[i].strip() == '':
                    i += 1
                while i < n:
                    cur = lines[i]
                    if cur.startswith('Q:') or cur.startswith('C:'):
                        break
                    if cur.strip() == '' and i + 1 < n and lines[i+1].strip() == '':
                        i += 1
                        break
                    cloze_parts.append(cur)
                    i += 1
            
            while cloze_parts and cloze_parts[-1].strip() == '':
                cloze_parts.pop()
            
            cloze_raw = '\n'.join(cloze_parts)
            line_end = i - 1
            
            while i < n and lines[i].strip() == '':
                i += 1
            
            text_no_brackets = re.sub(r'\[([^\]]*)\]', r'\1', cloze_raw)
            blanks = list(re.finditer(r'\[([^\]]*)\]', cloze_raw))
            
            if not blanks:
                continue
            
            family_hash = compute_family_hash(text_no_brackets)
            
            for blank in blanks:
                blank_content = blank.group(1)
                prefix_raw = cloze_raw[:blank.start()]
                prefix_clean = re.sub(r'\[([^\]]*)\]', r'\1', prefix_raw)
                start_byte = len(prefix_clean.encode('utf-8'))
                end_byte = start_byte + len(blank_content.encode('utf-8')) - 1
                
                content_obj = {
                    'cloze': {
                        'text': text_no_brackets,
                        'start': start_byte,
                        'end': end_byte
                    }
                }
                cards.append({
                    'hash': compute_card_hash(content_obj),
                    'familyHash': family_hash,
                    'deckName': deck_name,
                    'location': {
                        'filePath': os.path.abspath(file_path),
                        'lineStart': line_start,
                        'lineEnd': line_end
                    },
                    'content': content_obj,
                    'performance': None
                })
        else:
            i += 1
    
    return cards


def collect_cards(directory):
    all_cards = []
    md_files = sorted(f for f in os.listdir(directory) if f.endswith('.md'))
    for fn in md_files:
        fp = os.path.join(directory, fn)
        try:
            all_cards.extend(parse_markdown_file(fp))
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Warning: error parsing {fp}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
    return all_cards


def collect_macros(directory):
    macros_file = os.path.join(directory, 'macros.tex')
    macros = {}
    if os.path.exists(macros_file):
        with open(macros_file, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            for line in f:
                line = line.strip()
                if line:
                    parts = line.split(' ', 1)
                    if len(parts) == 2 and parts[0].startswith('\\'):
                        macros[parts[0]] = parts[1]
    return macros

# ============================================================
# FSRS ALGORITHM
# ============================================================

# Parameters derived from observing the original binary
W0 = 0.40255   # Initial stability: Forgot
W1 = 1.18385   # Initial stability: Hard
W2 = 3.173     # Initial stability: Good
W3 = 15.69105  # Initial stability: Easy
W4 = 7.1949    # Initial difficulty base
W5 = 0.5345    # Initial difficulty exponent
W6 = 0.5791    # Difficulty update coefficient
W7 = 0.01264   # Difficulty mean reversion weight
W8 = -2.463    # Recall stability: w8
W9 = 0.1192    # Recall stability: S exponent
W10 = 6.03     # Recall stability: R factor
W11 = 0.329915 # Forgot stability: base
W12 = 0.107486 # Forgot stability: D exponent
W13 = 0.571985 # Forgot stability: S exponent
W14 = 2.172223 # Forgot stability: R factor
W15 = 0.2315   # Hard multiplier (on S-increment)
W16 = 2.9898   # Easy multiplier (on S-increment)
FACTOR = 4.33  # Retrievability formula factor
MAX_INTERVAL = 256

INITIAL_STABILITY = {
    'forgot': W0, 'hard': W1, 'good': W2, 'easy': W3
}

GRADE_NUM = {'forgot': 1, 'hard': 2, 'good': 3, 'easy': 4}


def D0(grade):
    """Initial difficulty for a grade."""
    r = GRADE_NUM[grade]
    return max(1.0, min(10.0, W4 - math.exp(W5 * (r - 1)) + 1))


def update_difficulty(d, grade):
    """Update difficulty based on grade."""
    r = GRADE_NUM[grade]
    d_prime = W7 * D0('good') + (1 - W7) * (d - W6 * (r - 3))
    return max(1.0, min(10.0, d_prime))


def retrievability(elapsed, s):
    """R(t, S) = (1 + FACTOR*t/S)^{-1/FACTOR}"""
    if s <= 0:
        return 0.0
    return (1 + FACTOR * elapsed / s) ** (-1.0 / FACTOR)


def new_stability_recall(s, d, elapsed, grade):
    """New stability after successful recall."""
    R = retrievability(elapsed, s)
    k = math.exp(W8) * (11 - d) * (s ** (-W9))
    term = math.exp(W10 * (1 - R)) - 1
    s_good = s * (1 + k * term)
    
    if grade == 'hard':
        return s + (s_good - s) * W15
    elif grade == 'easy':
        return s + (s_good - s) * W16
    else:  # good
        return s_good


def new_stability_forgot(s, d, elapsed):
    """New stability after forgetting."""
    R = retrievability(elapsed, s)
    return W11 * (d ** (-W12)) * (s ** W13) * math.exp(W14 * (1 - R))


def compute_interval(stability):
    return max(1, min(MAX_INTERVAL, round(stability)))


def process_review(card_data, grade, elapsed_days):
    """Process a review, return (stability, difficulty, interval_raw, interval_days, due_date)."""
    review_count = card_data.get('review_count', 0)
    
    if review_count == 0:
        s = INITIAL_STABILITY[grade]
        d = D0(grade)
    else:
        s = card_data['stability']
        d = card_data['difficulty']
        
        if grade == 'forgot':
            s = new_stability_forgot(s, d, elapsed_days)
        else:
            s = new_stability_recall(s, d, elapsed_days, grade)
        
        d = update_difficulty(d, grade)
    
    s = max(0.001, s)
    d = max(1.0, min(10.0, d))
    
    interval_days = compute_interval(s)
    interval_raw = s
    today = date.today()
    due_date = (today + timedelta(days=interval_days)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    
    return s, d, interval_raw, interval_days, due_date

class DrillState:
    def __init__(self, queue, card_map, conn, answer_controls='full', bury_siblings=True):
        self.queue = list(queue)
        self.card_map = card_map
        self.conn = conn
        self.answer_controls = answer_controls
        self.bury_siblings = bury_siblings
        
        self.current = None
        self.revealed = False
        self.completed = []  # (hash, grade, ...) processed cards
        self.total = len(self.queue)
        self.reviewed_count = 0
        self.undo_available = False
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        
        self.started_at = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f')[:-3]
        self.ended = False
        self.session_ended_at = None
        self.session_id = None
        
        self._advance()
    
    def _advance(self):
        if self.queue:
            self.current = self.queue.pop(0)
            self.revealed = False
        else:
            self.current = None
    
    def reveal(self):
        with self.lock:
            self.revealed = True
    
    def grade_card(self, grade):
        with self.lock:
            if self.current is None or self.ended:
                return
            
            card_hash = self.current
            cursor = self.conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM cards WHERE card_hash = ?', (card_hash,))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            
            if row is None:
                self._advance()
                return
            
            cols = ['card_hash', 'added_at', 'last_reviewed_at', 'stability', 'difficulty',
                    'interval_raw', 'interval_days', 'due_date', 'review_count']
            card_data = dict(zip(cols, row))
            
            last_reviewed = card_data.get('last_reviewed_at')
            if last_reviewed:
                try:
                    last_dt = datetime.strptime(last_reviewed[:19], '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')
                    elapsed_days = max(0, (datetime.now() - last_dt).days)
                except:
                    elapsed_days = 0
            else:
                elapsed_days = 0
            
            new_s, new_d, new_raw, new_days, due_date = process_review(card_data, grade, elapsed_days)
            reviewed_at = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f')[:-3]
            
            cursor.execute('''UPDATE cards SET
                last_reviewed_at = ?,
                stability = ?,
                difficulty = ?,
                interval_raw = ?,
                interval_days = ?,
                due_date = ?,
                review_count = review_count + 1
                WHERE card_hash = ?''',
                (reviewed_at, new_s, new_d, new_raw, new_days, due_date, card_hash))
            
            # Save with session_id=0 for now
            cursor.execute('''INSERT INTO reviews
                (session_id, card_hash, reviewed_at, grade, stability, difficulty, interval_raw, interval_days, due_date)
                VALUES (0, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)''',
                (card_hash, reviewed_at, grade, new_s, new_d, new_raw, new_days, due_date))
            
            self.completed.append((card_hash, grade))
            self.reviewed_count += 1
            self.undo_available = True
            
            # Re-queue if forgot
            if grade == 'forgot':
                insert_pos = min(len(self.queue), 10)
                self.queue.insert(insert_pos, card_hash)
                self.total = max(self.total, self.reviewed_count + len(self.queue))
            
            # Bury siblings
            if self.bury_siblings:
                card = self.card_map.get(card_hash, {})
                family = card.get('familyHash')
                if family:
                    siblings = [c['hash'] for c in self.card_map.values()
                               if c.get('familyHash') == family and c['hash'] != card_hash]
                    self.queue = [h for h in self.queue if h not in siblings]
            
            self._advance()
    
    def undo(self):
        with self.lock:
            if not self.undo_available or not self.completed:
                return
            
            last_hash, last_grade = self.completed.pop()
            
            # Revert the card state
            cursor = self.conn.cursor()
            
            # Get the previous review to restore state
            cursor.execute('''SELECT * FROM reviews WHERE card_hash = ? AND session_id = 0
                             ORDER BY review_id DESC LIMIT 2''', (last_hash,))
            reviews = cursor.fetchall()
            
            if len(reviews) >= 2:
                # Restore to previous review state
                prev = reviews[1]
                prev_reviewed_at = prev[3]
                prev_stability = prev[5]
                prev_difficulty = prev[6]
                prev_raw = prev[7]
                prev_days = prev[8]
                prev_due = prev[9]
                cursor.execute('''UPDATE cards SET
                    last_reviewed_at = ?,
                    stability = ?,
                    difficulty = ?,
                    interval_raw = ?,
                    interval_days = ?,
                    due_date = ?,
                    review_count = review_count - 1
                    WHERE card_hash = ?''',
                    (prev_reviewed_at, prev_stability, prev_difficulty, prev_raw, prev_days, prev_due, last_hash))
            else:
                # This was the first review
                cursor.execute('''UPDATE cards SET
                    last_reviewed_at = NULL,
                    stability = NULL,
                    difficulty = NULL,
                    interval_raw = NULL,
                    interval_days = NULL,
                    due_date = NULL,
                    review_count = 0
                    WHERE card_hash = ?''', (last_hash,))
            
            # Remove the last review record
            cursor.execute('''DELETE FROM reviews WHERE review_id = (
                SELECT MAX(review_id) FROM reviews WHERE card_hash = ? AND session_id = 0
            )''', (last_hash,))
            
            # Put current back in queue if different
            if self.current and self.current != last_hash:
                self.queue.insert(0, self.current)
            
            self.current = last_hash
            self.revealed = False
            self.reviewed_count -= 1
            self.undo_available = bool(self.completed)
    
    def end_session(self):
        with self.lock:
            if self.ended:
                return self.session_id, self.started_at, self.session_ended_at
            
            ended_at = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f')[:-3]
            cursor = self.conn.cursor()
            
            cursor.execute('INSERT INTO sessions (started_at, ended_at) VALUES (?, ?)',
                          (self.started_at, ended_at))
            session_id = cursor.lastrowid
            
            cursor.execute('UPDATE reviews SET session_id = ? WHERE session_id = 0',
                          (session_id,))
            
            self.conn.commit()
            self.ended = True
            self.session_id = session_id
            self.session_ended_at = ended_at
            return session_id, self.started_at, ended_at
    
    def progress_pct(self):
        if self.total == 0:
            return 0.0
        return (self.reviewed_count / self.total) * 100.0
    
    def is_done(self):
        return self.current is None

_HTML_ENTITIES = {
    '&': '&',
    '<': '<',
    '>': '>',
    '"': '"',
}

def html_escape(s):
    for char, entity in _HTML_ENTITIES.items():
        s = s.replace(char, entity)
    return s


def render_inline(text):
    """Render inline markdown to HTML."""
    # Display math first ($$...$$)
    text = re.sub(r'\$\$([\s\S]+?)\$\$',
                  lambda m: f'<span class="math-display">{m.group(1)}</span>', text)
    # Inline math ($...$)
    text = re.sub(r'\$([^\$\n]+?)\$',
                  lambda m: f'<span class="math-inline">{m.group(1)}</span>', text)
    # Bold+italic
    text = re.sub(r'\*\*\*(.+?)\*\*\*', r'<strong><em>\1</em></strong>', text)
    # Bold
    text = re.sub(r'\*\*(.+?)\*\*', r'<strong>\1</strong>', text)
    # Italic
    text = re.sub(r'\*([^\*\n]+)\*', r'<em>\1</em>', text)
    text = re.sub(r'_([^_\n]+)_', r'<em>\1</em>', text)
    # Code
    text = re.sub(r'`([^`]+)`', r'<code>\1</code>', text)
    
    # Images/audio
    def handle_img(m):
        alt = m.group(1)
        src = m.group(2)
        if src.startswith('@/'):
            src = '/file/' + src[2:]
        
        ext = os.path.splitext(src)[1].lower()
        if ext in ('.mp3', '.ogg', '.wav', '.flac'):
            full_src = f'http://localhost:8000{src}' if src.startswith('/') else src
            return f'<audio controls src="{full_src}" title="{html_escape(alt)}"></audio>'
        elif ext in ('.mp4', '.webm'):
            full_src = f'http://localhost:8000{src}' if src.startswith('/') else src
            return f'<video controls src="{full_src}"></video>'
        else:
            full_src = f'http://localhost:8000{src}' if src.startswith('/') else src
            return f'<img src="{full_src}" alt="{html_escape(alt)}">'
    
    text = re.sub(r'!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]*)\)', handle_img, text)
    return text


def render_markdown(text):
    """Convert markdown text to HTML."""
    if not text:
        return ''
    
    # Handle display math blocks ($$...$$ spanning multiple lines)
    def replace_display_math(m):
        return f'<span class="math-display">{m.group(1)}</span>'
    
    text = re.sub(r'\$\$([\s\S]+?)\$\$', replace_display_math, text)
    
    lines = text.split('\n')
    result = []
    i = 0
    in_list = False
    
    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i]
        
        # List items
        if re.match(r'^[-*]\s', line):
            if not in_list:
                result.append('<ul>')
                in_list = True
            item_text = line[2:]
            result.append(f'<li>{render_inline(item_text)}</li>')
        else:
            if in_list:
                result.append('</ul>')
                in_list = False
            
            if line.strip() == '':
                pass  # skip blank lines (paragraph separator)
            else:
                result.append(f'<p>{render_inline(line)}</p>')
        
        i += 1
    
    if in_list:
        result.append('</ul>')
    
    return '\n'.join(result)

def render_finished_page(state, started_at, ended_at):
    """Render the session finished page."""
    try:
        started_dt = datetime.strptime(started_at[:19], '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')
        ended_dt = datetime.strptime(ended_at[:19], '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')
        duration = int((ended_dt - started_dt).total_seconds())
    except:
        duration = 0
    
    count = state.reviewed_count
    pace = f'{duration / count:.2f}' if count > 0 else '0.00'
    started_str = started_at[:19].replace('T', ' ')
    ended_str = ended_at[:19].replace('T', ' ')
    
    body = f'<div class="finished"><h1>Session Completed 🎉</h1><div class="summary">Reviewed {count} cards in {duration} seconds.</div><h2>Session Stats</h2><div class="stats"><table><tbody><tr><td class="key">Total Cards</td><td class="val">{state.total}</td></tr><tr><td class="key">Cards Reviewed</td><td class="val">{count}</td></tr><tr><td class="key">Started</td><td class="val">{started_str}</td></tr><tr><td class="key">Finished</td><td class="val">{ended_str}</td></tr><tr><td class="key">Duration (seconds)</td><td class="val">{duration}</td></tr><tr><td class="key">Pace (s/card)</td><td class="val">{pace}</td></tr></tbody></table></div><div class="shutdown-container"><form action="/" method="post"><input class="shutdown-button" id="shutdown" type="submit" name="action" value="Shutdown" title="Shut down the server"></form></div></div>'

class DrillHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):

    macros = {}
    shutdown_event = None
    deck_dir = None
    resource_dir = None
    
    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        pass
    
    def send_bytes(self, data, ctype, cache=False):
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', ctype)
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(data)))
        if cache:
            self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'public, max-age=604800, immutable')
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)
    
    def do_GET(self):
        path = urlparse(self.path).path
        
        if path == '/':
            if DrillHandler.finished_html:
                html = DrillHandler.finished_html
            elif DrillHandler.state:
                if DrillHandler.state.is_done():
                    html = '<html><body>Queue empty.</body></html>'
                else:
                    html = render_drill_page(DrillHandler.state) or '<html><body>Error</body></html>'
            else:
                html = '<html><body>No session.</body></html>'
            self.send_bytes(html.encode('utf-8'), 'text/html; charset=utf-8')
        
        elif path == '/style.css':
            data = open(os.path.join(DrillHandler.resource_dir, 'style.css'), 'rb').read()
            self.send_bytes(data, 'text/css', cache=True)
        
        elif path == '/script.js':
            base = open(os.path.join(DrillHandler.resource_dir, 'script_base.js'), 'r').read()
            macro_lines = 'let MACROS = {};\n'
            for k, v in DrillHandler.macros.items():
                v_esc = v.replace('\\', '\\\\').replace("'", "\\'")
                macro_lines += f"MACROS['{k}'] = '{v_esc}';\n"
            script = macro_lines + '\n' + base
            self.send_bytes(script.encode('utf-8'), 'text/javascript')
        
        elif path == '/katex/katex.css':
            data = open(os.path.join(DrillHandler.resource_dir, 'katex.css'), 'rb').read()
            self.send_bytes(data, 'text/css', cache=True)
        
        elif path == '/katex/katex.js':
            data = open(os.path.join(DrillHandler.resource_dir, 'katex.js'), 'rb').read()
            self.send_bytes(data, 'text/javascript', cache=True)
        
        elif path == '/katex/mhchem.js':
            data = open(os.path.join(DrillHandler.resource_dir, 'mhchem.js'), 'rb').read()
            self.send_bytes(data, 'text/javascript', cache=True)
        
        elif path.startswith('/katex/fonts/'):
            fname = os.path.basename(path)
            fpath = os.path.join(DrillHandler.resource_dir, 'fonts', fname)
            if os.path.exists(fpath):
                data = open(fpath, 'rb').read()
                ext = os.path.splitext(fname)[1].lower()
                ct = {'woff2': 'font/woff2', 'woff': 'font/woff', 'ttf': 'font/truetype'}.get(ext[1:], 'application/octet-stream')
                self.send_bytes(data, ct, cache=True)
            else:
                self.send_error(404)
        
        elif path.startswith('/file/'):
            fname = path[6:]
            fpath = os.path.join(DrillHandler.deck_dir, fname)
            if os.path.exists(fpath):
                data = open(fpath, 'rb').read()
                ext = os.path.splitext(fname)[1].lower()
                ct_map = {
                    '.mp3': 'audio/mpeg', '.ogg': 'audio/ogg', '.wav': 'audio/wav',
                    '.mp4': 'video/mp4', '.webm': 'video/webm',
                    '.jpg': 'image/jpeg', '.jpeg': 'image/jpeg',
                    '.png': 'image/png', '.gif': 'image/gif',
                    '.webp': 'image/webp', '.svg': 'image/svg+xml',
                }
                ct = ct_map.get(ext, 'application/octet-stream')
                self.send_bytes(data, ct)
            else:
                self.send_error(404)
        else:
            self.send_error(404)
    
    def do_POST(self):
        ct = self.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
        if 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' not in ct:
            self.send_response(415)
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(b'Form requests must have `Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded`')
            return
        
        length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', 0))
        body = self.rfile.read(length).decode('utf-8')
        params = parse_qs(body)
        action = params.get('action', [''])[0]
        
        state = DrillHandler.state
        
        if action == 'Reveal' and state and not state.ended:
            state.reveal()
        elif action in ('Forgot', 'Hard', 'Good', 'Easy') and state and not state.ended:
            state.grade_card(action.lower())
        elif action == 'Undo' and state and not state.ended:
            state.undo()
        elif action == 'End':
            if state and not state.ended:
                _, started_at, ended_at = state.end_session()
                DrillHandler.finished_html = render_finished_page(state, started_at, ended_at)
                DrillHandler.state = None
        elif action == 'Shutdown':
            if DrillHandler.shutdown_event:
                DrillHandler.shutdown_event.set()
            self.send_response(303)
            self.send_header('Location', '/')
            self.send_header('Content-Length', '0')
            self.end_headers()
            return
        
        self.send_response(303)
        self.send_header('Location', '/')
        self.send_header('Content-Length', '0')
        self.end_headers()

def cmd_drill(directory, host='127.0.0.1', port=8000, card_limit=None,
              new_card_limit=None, from_deck=None, open_browser=True,
              answer_controls='full', bury_siblings=True):
    conn = init_db(directory)
    all_cards = collect_cards(directory)
    
    if from_deck:
        all_cards = [c for c in all_cards if c['deckName'] == from_deck]
    
    sync_cards_to_db(conn, all_cards)
    card_map = {c['hash']: c for c in all_cards}
    
    today = date.today().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    # New cards
    cursor.execute('''SELECT card_hash FROM cards WHERE review_count = 0 ORDER BY added_at''')
    new_hashes = [r[0] for r in cursor.fetchall() if r[0] in card_map]
    
    # Due cards
    cursor.execute('''SELECT card_hash FROM cards WHERE review_count > 0 AND due_date <= ? ORDER BY due_date ASC''',
                  (today,))
    due_hashes = [r[0] for r in cursor.fetchall() if r[0] in card_map]
    
    if new_card_limit is not None:
        new_hashes = new_hashes[:new_card_limit]
    
    all_due = due_hashes + new_hashes
    
    if card_limit is not None:
        all_due = all_due[:card_limit]
    
    macros = collect_macros(directory)
    
    # Set up handler class state
    DrillHandler.state = DrillState(all_due, card_map, conn,
                                     answer_controls=answer_controls,
                                     bury_siblings=bury_siblings)
    DrillHandler.finished_html = None
    DrillHandler.macros = macros
    DrillHandler.deck_dir = directory
    DrillHandler.resource_dir = _RESOURCE_DIR
    
    shutdown_event = threading.Event()
    DrillHandler.shutdown_event = shutdown_event
    
    httpd = HTTPServer((host, port), DrillHandler)
    
    def serve():
        while not shutdown_event.is_set():
            httpd.handle_request()
        httpd.server_close()
    
    t = threading.Thread(target=serve, daemon=True)
    t.start()
    
    print(f"Serving on http://{host}:{port}/")
    
    if open_browser:
        threading.Timer(0.5, lambda: webbrowser.open(f'http://{host}:{port}/')).start()
    
    shutdown_event.wait()
    conn.close()

                prefix_clean = re.sub(r'\[([^\]]*)\]', r'\1', prefix_raw)
                start_byte = len(prefix_clean.encode('utf-8'))
                end_byte = start_byte + len(blank_content.encode('utf-8')) - 1
                
                content_obj = {
                    'cloze': {
                        'text': text_no_brackets,
                        'start': start_byte,
                        'end': end_byte
                    }
                }
                cards.append({
                    'hash': compute_card_hash(content_obj),
                    'familyHash': family_hash,
                    'deckName': deck_name,
                    'location': {
                        'filePath': os.path.abspath(file_path),
                        'lineStart': line_start,
                        'lineEnd': line_end
                    },
                    'content': content_obj,
                    'performance': None
                })
        else:
            i += 1
    
    return cards


def collect_cards(directory):
    all_cards = []
    md_files = sorted(f for f in os.listdir(directory) if f.endswith('.md'))
    for fn in md_files:
        fp = os.path.join(directory, fn)
        try:
            all_cards.extend(parse_markdown_file(fp))
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Warning: error parsing {fp}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
    return all_cards


def collect_macros(directory):
    macros_file = os.path.join(directory, 'macros.tex')
    macros = {}
    if os.path.exists(macros_file):
        with open(macros_file, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            for line in f:
                line = line.strip()
                if line:
                    parts = line.split(' ', 1)
                    if len(parts) == 2 and parts[0].startswith('\\'):
                        macros[parts[0]] = parts[1]
    return macros

        )
    conn.commit()


# ============================================================
# FSRS ALGORITHM
# ============================================================

# Parameters derived from observing the original binary
W0 = 0.40255   # Initial stability: Forgot
W1 = 1.18385   # Initial stability: Hard
W2 = 3.173     # Initial stability: Good
W3 = 15.69105  # Initial stability: Easy
W4 = 7.1949    # Initial difficulty base
W5 = 0.5345    # Initial difficulty exponent
W6 = 0.5791    # Difficulty update coefficient
W7 = 0.01264   # Difficulty mean reversion weight
W8 = -2.463    # Recall stability: w8
W9 = 0.1192    # Recall stability: S exponent
W10 = 6.03     # Recall stability: R factor
W11 = 0.329915 # Forgot stability: base
W12 = 0.107486 # Forgot stability: D exponent
W13 = 0.571985 # Forgot stability: S exponent
W14 = 2.172223 # Forgot stability: R factor
W15 = 0.2315   # Hard multiplier (on S-increment)
W16 = 2.9898   # Easy multiplier (on S-increment)
FACTOR = 4.33  # Retrievability formula factor
MAX_INTERVAL = 256

INITIAL_STABILITY = {
    'forgot': W0, 'hard': W1, 'good': W2, 'easy': W3
}

GRADE_NUM = {'forgot': 1, 'hard': 2, 'good': 3, 'easy': 4}


def D0(grade):
    """Initial difficulty for a grade."""
    r = GRADE_NUM[grade]
    return max(1.0, min(10.0, W4 - math.exp(W5 * (r - 1)) + 1))


def update_difficulty(d, grade):
    """Update difficulty based on grade."""
    r = GRADE_NUM[grade]
    d_prime = W7 * D0('good') + (1 - W7) * (d - W6 * (r - 3))
    return max(1.0, min(10.0, d_prime))


def retrievability(elapsed, s):
    """R(t, S) = (1 + FACTOR*t/S)^{-1/FACTOR}"""
    if s <= 0:
        return 0.0
    return (1 + FACTOR * elapsed / s) ** (-1.0 / FACTOR)


def new_stability_recall(s, d, elapsed, grade):
    """New stability after successful recall."""
    R = retrievability(elapsed, s)
    k = math.exp(W8) * (11 - d) * (s ** (-W9))
    term = math.exp(W10 * (1 - R)) - 1
    s_good = s * (1 + k * term)
    
    if grade == 'hard':
        return s + (s_good - s) * W15
    elif grade == 'easy':
        return s + (s_good - s) * W16
    else:  # good
        return s_good


def new_stability_forgot(s, d, elapsed):
    """New stability after forgetting."""
    R = retrievability(elapsed, s)
    return W11 * (d ** (-W12)) * (s ** W13) * math.exp(W14 * (1 - R))


def compute_interval(stability):
    return max(1, min(MAX_INTERVAL, round(stability)))


def process_review(card_data, grade, elapsed_days):
    """Process a review, return (stability, difficulty, interval_raw, interval_days, due_date)."""
    review_count = card_data.get('review_count', 0)
    
    if review_count == 0:
        s = INITIAL_STABILITY[grade]
        d = D0(grade)
    else:
        s = card_data['stability']
        d = card_data['difficulty']
        
        if grade == 'forgot':
            s = new_stability_forgot(s, d, elapsed_days)
        else:
            s = new_stability_recall(s, d, elapsed_days, grade)
        
        d = update_difficulty(d, grade)
    
    s = max(0.001, s)
    d = max(1.0, min(10.0, d))
    
    interval_days = compute_interval(s)
    interval_raw = s
    today = date.today()
    due_date = (today + timedelta(days=interval_days)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    
    return s, d, interval_raw, interval_days, due_date

# ============================================================

class DrillState:
    def __init__(self, queue, card_map, conn, answer_controls='full', bury_siblings=True):
        self.queue = list(queue)
        self.card_map = card_map
        self.conn = conn
        self.answer_controls = answer_controls
        self.bury_siblings = bury_siblings
        
        self.current = None
        self.revealed = False
        self.completed = []  # (hash, grade, ...) processed cards
        self.total = len(self.queue)
        self.reviewed_count = 0
        self.undo_available = False
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        
        self.started_at = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f')[:-3]
        self.ended = False
        self.session_ended_at = None
        self.session_id = None
        
        self._advance()
    
    def _advance(self):
        if self.queue:
            self.current = self.queue.pop(0)
            self.revealed = False
        else:
            self.current = None
    
    def reveal(self):
        with self.lock:
            self.revealed = True
    
    def grade_card(self, grade):
        with self.lock:
            if self.current is None or self.ended:
                return
            
            card_hash = self.current
            cursor = self.conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM cards WHERE card_hash = ?', (card_hash,))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            
            if row is None:
                self._advance()
                return
            
            cols = ['card_hash', 'added_at', 'last_reviewed_at', 'stability', 'difficulty',
                    'interval_raw', 'interval_days', 'due_date', 'review_count']
            card_data = dict(zip(cols, row))
            
            last_reviewed = card_data.get('last_reviewed_at')
            if last_reviewed:
                try:
                    last_dt = datetime.strptime(last_reviewed[:19], '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')
                    elapsed_days = max(0, (datetime.now() - last_dt).days)
                except:
                    elapsed_days = 0
            else:
                elapsed_days = 0
            
            new_s, new_d, new_raw, new_days, due_date = process_review(card_data, grade, elapsed_days)
            reviewed_at = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f')[:-3]
            
            cursor.execute('''UPDATE cards SET
                last_reviewed_at = ?,
                stability = ?,
                difficulty = ?,
                interval_raw = ?,
                interval_days = ?,
                due_date = ?,
                review_count = review_count + 1
                WHERE card_hash = ?''',
                (reviewed_at, new_s, new_d, new_raw, new_days, due_date, card_hash))
            
            # Save with session_id=0 for now
            cursor.execute('''INSERT INTO reviews
                (session_id, card_hash, reviewed_at, grade, stability, difficulty, interval_raw, interval_days, due_date)
                VALUES (0, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)''',
                (card_hash, reviewed_at, grade, new_s, new_d, new_raw, new_days, due_date))
            
            self.completed.append((card_hash, grade))
            self.reviewed_count += 1
            self.undo_available = True
            
            # Re-queue if forgot
            if grade == 'forgot':
                insert_pos = min(len(self.queue), 10)
                self.queue.insert(insert_pos, card_hash)
                self.total = max(self.total, self.reviewed_count + len(self.queue))
            
            # Bury siblings
            if self.bury_siblings:
                card = self.card_map.get(card_hash, {})
                family = card.get('familyHash')
                if family:
                    siblings = [c['hash'] for c in self.card_map.values()
                               if c.get('familyHash') == family and c['hash'] != card_hash]
                    self.queue = [h for h in self.queue if h not in siblings]
            
            self._advance()
    
    def undo(self):
        with self.lock:
            if not self.undo_available or not self.completed:
                return
            
            last_hash, last_grade = self.completed.pop()
            
            # Revert the card state
            cursor = self.conn.cursor()
            
            # Get the previous review to restore state
            cursor.execute('''SELECT * FROM reviews WHERE card_hash = ? AND session_id = 0
                             ORDER BY review_id DESC LIMIT 2''', (last_hash,))
            reviews = cursor.fetchall()
            
            if len(reviews) >= 2:
                # Restore to previous review state
                prev = reviews[1]
                prev_reviewed_at = prev[3]
                prev_stability = prev[5]
                prev_difficulty = prev[6]
                prev_raw = prev[7]
                prev_days = prev[8]
                prev_due = prev[9]
                cursor.execute('''UPDATE cards SET
                    last_reviewed_at = ?,
                    stability = ?,
                    difficulty = ?,
                    interval_raw = ?,
                    interval_days = ?,
                    due_date = ?,
                    review_count = review_count - 1
                    WHERE card_hash = ?''',
                    (prev_reviewed_at, prev_stability, prev_difficulty, prev_raw, prev_days, prev_due, last_hash))
            else:
                # This was the first review
                cursor.execute('''UPDATE cards SET
                    last_reviewed_at = NULL,
                    stability = NULL,
                    difficulty = NULL,
                    interval_raw = NULL,
                    interval_days = NULL,
                    due_date = NULL,
                    review_count = 0
                    WHERE card_hash = ?''', (last_hash,))
            
            # Remove the last review record
            cursor.execute('''DELETE FROM reviews WHERE review_id = (
                SELECT MAX(review_id) FROM reviews WHERE card_hash = ? AND session_id = 0
            )''', (last_hash,))
            
            # Put current back in queue if different
            if self.current and self.current != last_hash:
                self.queue.insert(0, self.current)
            
            self.current = last_hash
            self.revealed = False
            self.reviewed_count -= 1
            self.undo_available = bool(self.completed)
    
    def end_session(self):
        with self.lock:
            if self.ended:
                return self.session_id, self.started_at, self.session_ended_at
            
            ended_at = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f')[:-3]
            cursor = self.conn.cursor()
            
            cursor.execute('INSERT INTO sessions (started_at, ended_at) VALUES (?, ?)',
                          (self.started_at, ended_at))
            session_id = cursor.lastrowid
            
            cursor.execute('UPDATE reviews SET session_id = ? WHERE session_id = 0',
                          (session_id,))
            
            self.conn.commit()
            self.ended = True
            self.session_id = session_id
            self.session_ended_at = ended_at
            return session_id, self.started_at, ended_at
    
    def progress_pct(self):
        if self.total == 0:
            return 0.0
        return (self.reviewed_count / self.total) * 100.0
    
    def is_done(self):
        return self.current is None

_HTML_ENTITIES = {
    '&': '&',
    '<': '<',
    '>': '>',
    '"': '"',
}

def html_escape(s):
    for char, entity in _HTML_ENTITIES.items():
        s = s.replace(char, entity)
    return s


def render_inline(text):
    """Render inline markdown to HTML."""
    # Display math first ($$...$$)
    text = re.sub(r'\$\$([\s\S]+?)\$\$',
                  lambda m: f'<span class="math-display">{m.group(1)}</span>', text)
    # Inline math ($...$)
    text = re.sub(r'\$([^\$\n]+?)\$',
                  lambda m: f'<span class="math-inline">{m.group(1)}</span>', text)
    # Bold+italic
    text = re.sub(r'\*\*\*(.+?)\*\*\*', r'<strong><em>\1</em></strong>', text)
    # Bold
    text = re.sub(r'\*\*(.+?)\*\*', r'<strong>\1</strong>', text)
    # Italic
    text = re.sub(r'\*([^\*\n]+)\*', r'<em>\1</em>', text)
    text = re.sub(r'_([^_\n]+)_', r'<em>\1</em>', text)
    # Code
    text = re.sub(r'`([^`]+)`', r'<code>\1</code>', text)
    
    # Images/audio
    def handle_img(m):
        alt = m.group(1)
        src = m.group(2)
        if src.startswith('@/'):
            src = '/file/' + src[2:]
        
        ext = os.path.splitext(src)[1].lower()
        if ext in ('.mp3', '.ogg', '.wav', '.flac'):
            full_src = f'http://localhost:8000{src}' if src.startswith('/') else src
            return f'<audio controls src="{full_src}" title="{html_escape(alt)}"></audio>'
        elif ext in ('.mp4', '.webm'):
            full_src = f'http://localhost:8000{src}' if src.startswith('/') else src
            return f'<video controls src="{full_src}"></video>'
        else:
            full_src = f'http://localhost:8000{src}' if src.startswith('/') else src
            return f'<img src="{full_src}" alt="{html_escape(alt)}">'
    
    text = re.sub(r'!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]*)\)', handle_img, text)
    return text


def render_markdown(text):
    """Convert markdown text to HTML."""
    if not text:
        return ''
    
    # Handle display math blocks ($$...$$ spanning multiple lines)
    def replace_display_math(m):
        return f'<span class="math-display">{m.group(1)}</span>'
    
    text = re.sub(r'\$\$([\s\S]+?)\$\$', replace_display_math, text)
    
    lines = text.split('\n')
    result = []
    i = 0
    in_list = False
    
    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i]
        
        # List items
        if re.match(r'^[-*]\s', line):
            if not in_list:
                result.append('<ul>')
                in_list = True
            item_text = line[2:]
            result.append(f'<li>{render_inline(item_text)}</li>')
        else:
            if in_list:
                result.append('</ul>')
                in_list = False
            
            if line.strip() == '':
                pass  # skip blank lines (paragraph separator)
            else:
                result.append(f'<p>{render_inline(line)}</p>')
        
        i += 1
    
    if in_list:
        result.append('</ul>')
    
    return '\n'.join(result)

def render_drill_page(state):

    if state.is_done():
        return None
    
    card_hash = state.current
    card = state.card_map.get(card_hash)
    if card is None:
        return None
    
    deck_name = card.get('deckName', '')
    content = card['content']
    progress = state.progress_pct()
    has_undo = state.undo_available
    
    # Render card content
    if 'basic' in content:
        q = content['basic']['question']
        a = content['basic']['answer']
        q_html = render_markdown(q)
        a_html = render_markdown(a)
        
        if state.revealed:
            card_html = f'<div class="card-content"><div class="question rich-text">{q_html}</div><div class="answer rich-text">{a_html}</div></div>'

    elif 'cloze' in content:
        text = content['cloze']['text']
        start = content['cloze']['start']
        end = content['cloze']['end']

        blank = text_bytes[start:end+1].decode('utf-8')
        after = text_bytes[end+1:].decode('utf-8')
        
        if state.revealed:
            prompt_text = before + f"<span class='cloze-answer'>{blank}</span>" + after
        else:
            prompt_text = before + "<span class='cloze'>.............</span>" + after
        
        prompt_html = render_markdown(prompt_text)
        card_html = f'<div class="card-content"><div class="prompt rich-text">{prompt_html}</div></div>'
    else:
        card_html = '<div class="card-content"></div>'
    
    # Controls
    undo_attrs = '' if has_undo else ' disabled'
    undo_title = ' title="Undo last action. Shortcut: u."' if has_undo else ''
    
    if state.revealed:
        if state.answer_controls == 'binary':
            grade_html = '<div class="grades"><input id="forgot" type="submit" name="action" value="Forgot" title="Mark card as forgotten. Shortcut: 1."><input id="good" type="submit" name="action" value="Good" title="Mark card as remembered well. Shortcut: 3."></div>'
        else:
            grade_html = '<div class="grades"><input id="forgot" type="submit" name="action" value="Forgot" title="Mark card as forgotten. Shortcut: 1."><input id="hard" type="submit" name="action" value="Hard" title="Mark card as difficult. Shortcut: 2."><input id="good" type="submit" name="action" value="Good" title="Mark card as remembered well. Shortcut: 3."><input id="easy" type="submit" name="action" value="Easy" title="Mark card as very easy. Shortcut: 4."></div>'
        
        controls = f'<div class="controls"><form action="/" method="post"><input id="undo" type="submit" name="action" value="Undo"{undo_attrs}{undo_title}><div class="spacer"></div>{grade_html}<div class="spacer"></div><input id="end" type="submit" name="action" value="End" title="End the session (changes are saved)"></form></div>'
    else:

Shortcut: space."><div class="spacer"></div><input id="end" type="submit" name="action" value="End" title="End the session (changes are saved)"></form></div>'
    
    body = f'<div class="root"><div class="header"><div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-fill" style="width: {progress:.0f}%;"></div></div></div><div class="card-container"><div class="card"><div class="card-header"><h1>{deck_name}</h1></div>{card_html}</div></div>{controls}</div>'
    
    return build_page(body)


def render_finished_page(state, started_at, ended_at):
    """Render the session finished page."""
    try:
        started_dt = datetime.strptime(started_at[:19], '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')
        ended_dt = datetime.strptime(ended_at[:19], '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')
        duration = int((ended_dt - started_dt).total_seconds())
    except:
        duration = 0
    
    count = state.reviewed_count
    pace = f'{duration / count:.2f}' if count > 0 else '0.00'
    started_str = started_at[:19].replace('T', ' ')
    ended_str = ended_at[:19].replace('T', ' ')
    
    body = f'<div class="finished"><h1>Session Completed 🎉</h1><div class="summary">Reviewed {count} cards in {duration} seconds.</div><h2>Session Stats</h2><div class="stats"><table><tbody><tr><td class="key">Total Cards</td><td class="val">{state.total}</td></tr><tr><td class="key">Cards Reviewed</td><td class="val">{count}</td></tr><tr><td class="key">Started</td><td class="val">{started_str}</td></tr><tr><td class="key">Finished</td><td class="val">{ended_str}</td></tr><tr><td class="key">Duration (seconds)</td><td class="val">{duration}</td></tr><tr><td class="key">Pace (s/card)</td><td class="val">{pace}</td></tr></tbody></table></div><div class="shutdown-container"><form action="/" method="post"><input class="shutdown-button" id="shutdown" type="submit" name="action" value="Shutdown" title="Shut down the server"></form></div></div>'
    
    return build_page(body)

class DrillHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    # Class-level state shared across requests
    state = None
    finished_html = None
    macros = {}
    shutdown_event = None
    deck_dir = None
    resource_dir = None
    
    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        pass
    
    def send_bytes(self, data, ctype, cache=False):
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', ctype)
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(data)))
        if cache:
            self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'public, max-age=604800, immutable')
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)
    
    def do_GET(self):
        path = urlparse(self.path).path
        
        if path == '/':
            if DrillHandler.finished_html:
                html = DrillHandler.finished_html
            elif DrillHandler.state:
                if DrillHandler.state.is_done():
                    html = '<html><body>Queue empty.</body></html>'
                else:
                    html = render_drill_page(DrillHandler.state) or '<html><body>Error</body></html>'
            else:
                html = '<html><body>No session.</body></html>'
            self.send_bytes(html.encode('utf-8'), 'text/html; charset=utf-8')
        
        elif path == '/style.css':
            data = open(os.path.join(DrillHandler.resource_dir, 'style.css'), 'rb').read()
            self.send_bytes(data, 'text/css', cache=True)
        
        elif path == '/script.js':
            base = open(os.path.join(DrillHandler.resource_dir, 'script_base.js'), 'r').read()
            macro_lines = 'let MACROS = {};\n'
            for k, v in DrillHandler.macros.items():
                v_esc = v.replace('\\', '\\\\').replace("'", "\\'")
                macro_lines += f"MACROS['{k}'] = '{v_esc}';\n"

                self.send_bytes(data, ct, cache=True)

    def do_POST(self):
        ct = self.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
        if 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' not in ct:
            self.send_response(415)
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(b'Form requests must have `Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded`')
            return
        
        length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', 0))
        body = self.rfile.read(length).decode('utf-8')
        params = parse_qs(body)
        action = params.get('action', [''])[0]
        
        state = DrillHandler.state
        
        if action == 'Reveal' and state and not state.ended:
            state.reveal()
        elif action in ('Forgot', 'Hard', 'Good', 'Easy') and state and not state.ended:
            state.grade_card(action.lower())
        elif action == 'Undo' and state and not state.ended:
            state.undo()
        elif action == 'End':
            if state and not state.ended:
                _, started_at, ended_at = state.end_session()
                DrillHandler.finished_html = render_finished_page(state, started_at, ended_at)
                DrillHandler.state = None
        elif action == 'Shutdown':
            if DrillHandler.shutdown_event:
                DrillHandler.shutdown_event.set()
            self.send_response(303)
            self.send_header('Location', '/')
            self.send_header('Content-Length', '0')
            self.end_headers()
            return
        
        self.send_response(303)
        self.send_header('Location', '/')
        self.send_header('Content-Length', '0')
        self.end_headers()

def cmd_drill(directory, host='127.0.0.1', port=8000, card_limit=None,
              new_card_limit=None, from_deck=None, open_browser=True,
              answer_controls='full', bury_siblings=True):
    conn = init_db(directory)
    all_cards = collect_cards(directory)
    
    if from_deck:
        all_cards = [c for c in all_cards if c['deckName'] == from_deck]
    
    sync_cards_to_db(conn, all_cards)
    card_map = {c['hash']: c for c in all_cards}
    
    today = date.today().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    # New cards
    cursor.execute('''SELECT card_hash FROM cards WHERE review_count = 0 ORDER BY added_at''')
    new_hashes = [r[0] for r in cursor.fetchall() if r[0] in card_map]
    
    # Due cards
    cursor.execute('''SELECT card_hash FROM cards WHERE review_count > 0 AND due_date <= ? ORDER BY due_date ASC''',
                  (today,))
    due_hashes = [r[0] for r in cursor.fetchall() if r[0] in card_map]
    
    if new_card_limit is not None:
        new_hashes = new_hashes[:new_card_limit]
    
    all_due = due_hashes + new_hashes
    
    if card_limit is not None:
        all_due = all_due[:card_limit]
    
    macros = collect_macros(directory)
    
    # Set up handler class state
    DrillHandler.state = DrillState(all_due, card_map, conn,
                                     answer_controls=answer_controls,
                                     bury_siblings=bury_siblings)
    DrillHandler.finished_html = None
    DrillHandler.macros = macros
    DrillHandler.deck_dir = directory
    DrillHandler.resource_dir = _RESOURCE_DIR
    
    shutdown_event = threading.Event()
    DrillHandler.shutdown_event = shutdown_event
    
    httpd = HTTPServer((host, port), DrillHandler)
    
    def serve():
        while not shutdown_event.is_set():
            httpd.handle_request()
        httpd.server_close()
    
    t = threading.Thread(target=serve, daemon=True)
    t.start()
    
    print(f"Serving on http://{host}:{port}/")
    
    if open_browser:
        threading.Timer(0.5, lambda: webbrowser.open(f'http://{host}:{port}/')).start()
    
    shutdown_event.wait()
    conn.close()

def compute_card_hash(content):
    """Compute SHA256 hash of card content."""
    if 'basic' in content:
        q = content['basic']['question']
        a = content['basic']['answer']
        data = (q + a).encode('utf-8')
    elif 'cloze' in content:
        text = content['cloze']['text']

        end = content['cloze']['end']
        data = (text + '\x00' + str(start) + '\x00' + str(end)).encode('utf-8')
    else:

    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def compute_family_hash(text):

def parse_markdown_file(file_path):

def collect_cards(directory):
    all_cards = []
    md_files = sorted(f for f in os.listdir(directory) if f.endswith('.md'))
    for fn in md_files:
        fp = os.path.join(directory, fn)
        try:
            all_cards.extend(parse_markdown_file(fp))

                    if len(parts) == 2 and parts[0].startswith('\\'):

W15 = 0.2315   # Hard multiplier (on S-increment)
W16 = 2.9898   # Easy multiplier (on S-increment)
FACTOR = 4.33  # Retrievability formula factor
MAX_INTERVAL = 256

INITIAL_STABILITY = {
    'forgot': W0, 'hard': W1, 'good': W2, 'easy': W3
}

GRADE_NUM = {'forgot': 1, 'hard': 2, 'good': 3, 'easy': 4}


def D0(grade):
    """Initial difficulty for a grade."""
    r = GRADE_NUM[grade]
    return max(1.0, min(10.0, W4 - math.exp(W5 * (r - 1)) + 1))


def update_difficulty(d, grade):
    """Update difficulty based on grade."""
    r = GRADE_NUM[grade]
    d_prime = W7 * D0('good') + (1 - W7) * (d - W6 * (r - 3))
    return max(1.0, min(10.0, d_prime))


def retrievability(elapsed, s):
    """R(t, S) = (1 + FACTOR*t/S)^{-1/FACTOR}"""
    if s <= 0:
        return 0.0
    return (1 + FACTOR * elapsed / s) ** (-1.0 / FACTOR)


def new_stability_recall(s, d, elapsed, grade):
    """New stability after successful recall."""
    R = retrievability(elapsed, s)
    k = math.exp(W8) * (11 - d) * (s ** (-W9))
    term = math.exp(W10 * (1 - R)) - 1
    s_good = s * (1 + k * term)
    
    if grade == 'hard':
        return s + (s_good - s) * W15
    elif grade == 'easy':
        return s + (s_good - s) * W16
    else:  # good
        return s_good


def new_stability_forgot(s, d, elapsed):
    """New stability after forgetting."""
    R = retrievability(elapsed, s)
    return W11 * (d ** (-W12)) * (s ** W13) * math.exp(W14 * (1 - R))


def compute_interval(stability):
    return max(1, min(MAX_INTERVAL, round(stability)))


def process_review(card_data, grade, elapsed_days):
    """Process a review, return (stability, difficulty, interval_raw, interval_days, due_date)."""
    review_count = card_data.get('review_count', 0)
    
    if review_count == 0:
        s = INITIAL_STABILITY[grade]
        d = D0(grade)
    else:
        s = card_data['stability']
        d = card_data['difficulty']
        
        if grade == 'forgot':
            s = new_stability_forgot(s, d, elapsed_days)
        else:
            s = new_stability_recall(s, d, elapsed_days, grade)
        
        d = update_difficulty(d, grade)
    
    s = max(0.001, s)
    d = max(1.0, min(10.0, d))
    
    interval_days = compute_interval(s)
    interval_raw = s
    today = date.today()
    due_date = (today + timedelta(days=interval_days)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    
    return s, d, interval_raw, interval_days, due_date

class DrillState:
    def __init__(self, queue, card_map, conn, answer_controls='full', bury_siblings=True):
        self.queue = list(queue)
        self.card_map = card_map
        self.conn = conn
        self.answer_controls = answer_controls
        self.bury_siblings = bury_siblings
        
        self.current = None
        self.revealed = False
        self.completed = []  # (hash, grade, ...) processed cards
        self.total = len(self.queue)
        self.reviewed_count = 0
        self.undo_available = False
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        
        self.started_at = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f')[:-3]
        self.ended = False
        self.session_ended_at = None
        self.session_id = None
        
        self._advance()
    
    def _advance(self):
        if self.queue:
            self.current = self.queue.pop(0)
            self.revealed = False
        else:
            self.current = None
    
    def reveal(self):
        with self.lock:
            self.revealed = True
    
    def grade_card(self, grade):
        with self.lock:
            if self.current is None or self.ended:
                return
            
            card_hash = self.current
            cursor = self.conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM cards WHERE card_hash = ?', (card_hash,))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            
            if row is None:
                self._advance()
                return
            
            cols = ['card_hash', 'added_at', 'last_reviewed_at', 'stability', 'difficulty',
                    'interval_raw', 'interval_days', 'due_date', 'review_count']
            card_data = dict(zip(cols, row))
            
            last_reviewed = card_data.get('last_reviewed_at')
            if last_reviewed:
                try:
                    last_dt = datetime.strptime(last_reviewed[:19], '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')
                    elapsed_days = max(0, (datetime.now() - last_dt).days)
                except:
                    elapsed_days = 0
            else:
                elapsed_days = 0
            
            new_s, new_d, new_raw, new_days, due_date = process_review(card_data, grade, elapsed_days)
            reviewed_at = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f')[:-3]
            
            cursor.execute('''UPDATE cards SET
                last_reviewed_at = ?,
                stability = ?,
                difficulty = ?,
                interval_raw = ?,
                interval_days = ?,
                due_date = ?,
                review_count = review_count + 1
                WHERE card_hash = ?''',
                (reviewed_at, new_s, new_d, new_raw, new_days, due_date, card_hash))
            
            # Save with session_id=0 for now
            cursor.execute('''INSERT INTO reviews
                (session_id, card_hash, reviewed_at, grade, stability, difficulty, interval_raw, interval_days, due_date)
                VALUES (0, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)''',
                (card_hash, reviewed_at, grade, new_s, new_d, new_raw, new_days, due_date))
            
            self.completed.append((card_hash, grade))
            self.reviewed_count += 1
            self.undo_available = True
            
            # Re-queue if forgot
            if grade == 'forgot':
                insert_pos = min(len(self.queue), 10)
                self.queue.insert(insert_pos, card_hash)
                self.total = max(self.total, self.reviewed_count + len(self.queue))
            
            # Bury siblings
            if self.bury_siblings:
                card = self.card_map.get(card_hash, {})
                family = card.get('familyHash')
                if family:
                    siblings = [c['hash'] for c in self.card_map.values()
                               if c.get('familyHash') == family and c['hash'] != card_hash]
                    self.queue = [h for h in self.queue if h not in siblings]
            
            self._advance()
    
    def undo(self):
        with self.lock:
            if not self.undo_available or not self.completed:
                return
            
            last_hash, last_grade = self.completed.pop()
            
            # Revert the card state
            cursor = self.conn.cursor()
            
            # Get the previous review to restore state
            cursor.execute('''SELECT * FROM reviews WHERE card_hash = ? AND session_id = 0
                             ORDER BY review_id DESC LIMIT 2''', (last_hash,))
            reviews = cursor.fetchall()
            
            if len(reviews) >= 2:
                # Restore to previous review state
                prev = reviews[1]
                prev_reviewed_at = prev[3]
                prev_stability = prev[5]
                prev_difficulty = prev[6]
                prev_raw = prev[7]
                prev_days = prev[8]
                prev_due = prev[9]
                cursor.execute('''UPDATE cards SET
                    last_reviewed_at = ?,
                    stability = ?,
                    difficulty = ?,
                    interval_raw = ?,
                    interval_days = ?,
                    due_date = ?,
                    review_count = review_count - 1
                    WHERE card_hash = ?''',
                    (prev_reviewed_at, prev_stability, prev_difficulty, prev_raw, prev_days, prev_due, last_hash))
            else:
                # This was the first review
                cursor.execute('''UPDATE cards SET
                    last_reviewed_at = NULL,
                    stability = NULL,
                    difficulty = NULL,
                    interval_raw = NULL,
                    interval_days = NULL,
                    due_date = NULL,
                    review_count = 0
                    WHERE card_hash = ?''', (last_hash,))
            
            # Remove the last review record
            cursor.execute('''DELETE FROM reviews WHERE review_id = (
                SELECT MAX(review_id) FROM reviews WHERE card_hash = ? AND session_id = 0
            )''', (last_hash,))
            
            # Put current back in queue if different
            if self.current and self.current != last_hash:
                self.queue.insert(0, self.current)
            
            self.current = last_hash
            self.revealed = False
            self.reviewed_count -= 1
            self.undo_available = bool(self.completed)
    
    def end_session(self):
        with self.lock:
            if self.ended:
                return self.session_id, self.started_at, self.session_ended_at
            
            ended_at = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f')[:-3]
            cursor = self.conn.cursor()
            
            cursor.execute('INSERT INTO sessions (started_at, ended_at) VALUES (?, ?)',
                          (self.started_at, ended_at))
            session_id = cursor.lastrowid
            
            cursor.execute('UPDATE reviews SET session_id = ? WHERE session_id = 0',
                          (session_id,))
            
            self.conn.commit()
            self.ended = True
            self.session_id = session_id
            self.session_ended_at = ended_at
            return session_id, self.started_at, ended_at
    
    def progress_pct(self):
        if self.total == 0:
            return 0.0
        return (self.reviewed_count / self.total) * 100.0
    
    def is_done(self):
        return self.current is None
