_HTML_ENTITIES = {
    '&': '&',
    '<': '<',
    '>': '>',
    '"': '"',
}

def html_escape(s):
    for char, entity in _HTML_ENTITIES.items():
        s = s.replace(char, entity)
    return s


def render_inline(text):
    """Render inline markdown to HTML."""
    # Display math first ($$...$$)
    text = re.sub(r'\$\$([\s\S]+?)\$\$',
                  lambda m: f'<span class="math-display">{m.group(1)}</span>', text)
    # Inline math ($...$)
    text = re.sub(r'\$([^\$\n]+?)\$',
                  lambda m: f'<span class="math-inline">{m.group(1)}</span>', text)
    # Bold+italic
    text = re.sub(r'\*\*\*(.+?)\*\*\*', r'<strong><em>\1</em></strong>', text)
    # Bold
    text = re.sub(r'\*\*(.+?)\*\*', r'<strong>\1</strong>', text)
    # Italic
    text = re.sub(r'\*([^\*\n]+)\*', r'<em>\1</em>', text)
    text = re.sub(r'_([^_\n]+)_', r'<em>\1</em>', text)
    # Code
    text = re.sub(r'`([^`]+)`', r'<code>\1</code>', text)
    
    # Images/audio
    def handle_img(m):
        alt = m.group(1)
        src = m.group(2)
        if src.startswith('@/'):
            src = '/file/' + src[2:]
        
        ext = os.path.splitext(src)[1].lower()
        if ext in ('.mp3', '.ogg', '.wav', '.flac'):
            full_src = f'http://localhost:8000{src}' if src.startswith('/') else src
            return f'<audio controls src="{full_src}" title="{html_escape(alt)}"></audio>'
        elif ext in ('.mp4', '.webm'):
            full_src = f'http://localhost:8000{src}' if src.startswith('/') else src
            return f'<video controls src="{full_src}"></video>'
        else:
            full_src = f'http://localhost:8000{src}' if src.startswith('/') else src
            return f'<img src="{full_src}" alt="{html_escape(alt)}">'
    
    text = re.sub(r'!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]*)\)', handle_img, text)
    return text


def render_markdown(text):
    """Convert markdown text to HTML."""
    if not text:
        return ''
    
    # Handle display math blocks ($$...$$ spanning multiple lines)
    def replace_display_math(m):
        return f'<span class="math-display">{m.group(1)}</span>'
    
    text = re.sub(r'\$\$([\s\S]+?)\$\$', replace_display_math, text)
    
    lines = text.split('\n')
    result = []
    i = 0
    in_list = False
    
    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i]
        
        # List items
        if re.match(r'^[-*]\s', line):
            if not in_list:
                result.append('<ul>')
                in_list = True
            item_text = line[2:]
            result.append(f'<li>{render_inline(item_text)}</li>')
        else:
            if in_list:
                result.append('</ul>')
                in_list = False
            
            if line.strip() == '':
                pass  # skip blank lines (paragraph separator)
            else:
                result.append(f'<p>{render_inline(line)}</p>')
        
        i += 1
    
    if in_list:
        result.append('</ul>')
    
    return '\n'.join(result)


def build_page(body_content):
    return f'<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>hashcards</title><link rel="stylesheet" href="/katex/katex.css"><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/highlight.js/11.9.0/styles/github.min.css"><script defer src="/katex/katex.js"></script><script defer src="/katex/mhchem.js"></script><script defer src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/highlight.js/11.9.0/highlight.min.js"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="/style.css"><style>.card-content {{ opacity: 0; }}</style><noscript><style>.card-content {{ opacity: 1; }}</style></noscript></head><body>{body_content}<script src="/script.js"></script></body></html>'.replace('{{', '{').replace('}}', '}')


def render_drill_page(state):
    """Render the current drill card page."""
    if state.is_done():
        return None
    
    card_hash = state.current
    card = state.card_map.get(card_hash)
    if card is None:
        return None
    
    deck_name = card.get('deckName', '')
    content = card['content']
    progress = state.progress_pct()
    has_undo = state.undo_available
    
    # Render card content
    if 'basic' in content:
        q = content['basic']['question']
        a = content['basic']['answer']
        q_html = render_markdown(q)
        a_html = render_markdown(a)
        
        if state.revealed:
            card_html = f'<div class="card-content"><div class="question rich-text">{q_html}</div><div class="answer rich-text">{a_html}</div></div>'
        else:
            card_html = f'<div class="card-content"><div class="question rich-text">{q_html}</div><div class="answer rich-text"></div></div>'
    
    elif 'cloze' in content:
        text = content['cloze']['text']
        start = content['cloze']['start']
        end = content['cloze']['end']
        text_bytes = text.encode('utf-8')
        before = text_bytes[:start].decode('utf-8')
        blank = text_bytes[start:end+1].decode('utf-8')
        after = text_bytes[end+1:].decode('utf-8')
        
        if state.revealed:
            prompt_text = before + f"<span class='cloze-answer'>{blank}</span>" + after
        else:
            prompt_text = before + "<span class='cloze'>.............</span>" + after
        
        prompt_html = render_markdown(prompt_text)
        card_html = f'<div class="card-content"><div class="prompt rich-text">{prompt_html}</div></div>'
    else:
        card_html = '<div class="card-content"></div>'
    
    # Controls
    undo_attrs = '' if has_undo else ' disabled'
    undo_title = ' title="Undo last action. Shortcut: u."' if has_undo else ''
    
    if state.revealed:
        if state.answer_controls == 'binary':
            grade_html = '<div class="grades"><input id="forgot" type="submit" name="action" value="Forgot" title="Mark card as forgotten. Shortcut: 1."><input id="good" type="submit" name="action" value="Good" title="Mark card as remembered well. Shortcut: 3."></div>'
        else:
            grade_html = '<div class="grades"><input id="forgot" type="submit" name="action" value="Forgot" title="Mark card as forgotten. Shortcut: 1."><input id="hard" type="submit" name="action" value="Hard" title="Mark card as difficult. Shortcut: 2."><input id="good" type="submit" name="action" value="Good" title="Mark card as remembered well. Shortcut: 3."><input id="easy" type="submit" name="action" value="Easy" title="Mark card as very easy. Shortcut: 4."></div>'
        
        controls = f'<div class="controls"><form action="/" method="post"><input id="undo" type="submit" name="action" value="Undo"{undo_attrs}{undo_title}><div class="spacer"></div>{grade_html}<div class="spacer"></div><input id="end" type="submit" name="action" value="End" title="End the session (changes are saved)"></form></div>'
    else:
        controls = f'<div class="controls"><form action="/" method="post"><input id="undo" type="submit" name="action" value="Undo"{undo_attrs}{undo_title}><div class="spacer"></div><input id="reveal" type="submit" name="action" value="Reveal" title="Show the answer. Shortcut: space."><div class="spacer"></div><input id="end" type="submit" name="action" value="End" title="End the session (changes are saved)"></form></div>'
    
    body = f'<div class="root"><div class="header"><div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-fill" style="width: {progress:.0f}%;"></div></div></div><div class="card-container"><div class="card"><div class="card-header"><h1>{deck_name}</h1></div>{card_html}</div></div>{controls}</div>'
    
    return build_page(body)


def render_finished_page(state, started_at, ended_at):
    """Render the session finished page."""
    try:
        started_dt = datetime.strptime(started_at[:19], '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')
        ended_dt = datetime.strptime(ended_at[:19], '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')
        duration = int((ended_dt - started_dt).total_seconds())
    except:
        duration = 0
    
    count = state.reviewed_count
    pace = f'{duration / count:.2f}' if count > 0 else '0.00'
    started_str = started_at[:19].replace('T', ' ')
    ended_str = ended_at[:19].replace('T', ' ')
    
    body = f'<div class="finished"><h1>Session Completed 🎉</h1><div class="summary">Reviewed {count} cards in {duration} seconds.</div><h2>Session Stats</h2><div class="stats"><table><tbody><tr><td class="key">Total Cards</td><td class="val">{state.total}</td></tr><tr><td class="key">Cards Reviewed</td><td class="val">{count}</td></tr><tr><td class="key">Started</td><td class="val">{started_str}</td></tr><tr><td class="key">Finished</td><td class="val">{ended_str}</td></tr><tr><td class="key">Duration (seconds)</td><td class="val">{duration}</td></tr><tr><td class="key">Pace (s/card)</td><td class="val">{pace}</td></tr></tbody></table></div><div class="shutdown-container"><form action="/" method="post"><input class="shutdown-button" id="shutdown" type="submit" name="action" value="Shutdown" title="Shut down the server"></form></div></div>'
    
    return build_page(body)

class DrillHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    # Class-level state shared across requests
    state = None
    finished_html = None
    macros = {}
    shutdown_event = None
    deck_dir = None
    resource_dir = None
    
    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        pass
    
    def send_bytes(self, data, ctype, cache=False):
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', ctype)
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(data)))
        if cache:
            self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'public, max-age=604800, immutable')
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)
    
    def do_GET(self):
        path = urlparse(self.path).path
        
        if path == '/':
            if DrillHandler.finished_html:
                html = DrillHandler.finished_html
            elif DrillHandler.state:
                if DrillHandler.state.is_done():
                    html = '<html><body>Queue empty.</body></html>'
                else:
                    html = render_drill_page(DrillHandler.state) or '<html><body>Error</body></html>'
            else:
                html = '<html><body>No session.</body></html>'
            self.send_bytes(html.encode('utf-8'), 'text/html; charset=utf-8')
        
        elif path == '/style.css':
            data = open(os.path.join(DrillHandler.resource_dir, 'style.css'), 'rb').read()
            self.send_bytes(data, 'text/css', cache=True)
        
        elif path == '/script.js':
            base = open(os.path.join(DrillHandler.resource_dir, 'script_base.js'), 'r').read()
            macro_lines = 'let MACROS = {};\n'
            for k, v in DrillHandler.macros.items():
                v_esc = v.replace('\\', '\\\\').replace("'", "\\'")
                macro_lines += f"MACROS['{k}'] = '{v_esc}';\n"
            script = macro_lines + '\n' + base
            self.send_bytes(script.encode('utf-8'), 'text/javascript')
        
        elif path == '/katex/katex.css':
            data = open(os.path.join(DrillHandler.resource_dir, 'katex.css'), 'rb').read()
            self.send_bytes(data, 'text/css', cache=True)
        
        elif path == '/katex/katex.js':
            data = open(os.path.join(DrillHandler.resource_dir, 'katex.js'), 'rb').read()
            self.send_bytes(data, 'text/javascript', cache=True)
        
        elif path == '/katex/mhchem.js':
            data = open(os.path.join(DrillHandler.resource_dir, 'mhchem.js'), 'rb').read()
            self.send_bytes(data, 'text/javascript', cache=True)
        
        elif path.startswith('/katex/fonts/'):
            fname = os.path.basename(path)
            fpath = os.path.join(DrillHandler.resource_dir, 'fonts', fname)
            if os.path.exists(fpath):
                data = open(fpath, 'rb').read()
                ext = os.path.splitext(fname)[1].lower()
                ct = {'woff2': 'font/woff2', 'woff': 'font/woff', 'ttf': 'font/truetype'}.get(ext[1:], 'application/octet-stream')
                self.send_bytes(data, ct, cache=True)
            else:
                self.send_error(404)
        
        elif path.startswith('/file/'):
            fname = path[6:]
            fpath = os.path.join(DrillHandler.deck_dir, fname)
            if os.path.exists(fpath):
                data = open(fpath, 'rb').read()
                ext = os.path.splitext(fname)[1].lower()
                ct_map = {
                    '.mp3': 'audio/mpeg', '.ogg': 'audio/ogg', '.wav': 'audio/wav',
                    '.mp4': 'video/mp4', '.webm': 'video/webm',
                    '.jpg': 'image/jpeg', '.jpeg': 'image/jpeg',
                    '.png': 'image/png', '.gif': 'image/gif',
                    '.webp': 'image/webp', '.svg': 'image/svg+xml',
                }
                ct = ct_map.get(ext, 'application/octet-stream')
                self.send_bytes(data, ct)
            else:
                self.send_error(404)
        else:
            self.send_error(404)
    
    def do_POST(self):
        ct = self.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
        if 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' not in ct:
            self.send_response(415)
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(b'Form requests must have `Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded`')
            return
        
        length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', 0))
        body = self.rfile.read(length).decode('utf-8')
        params = parse_qs(body)
        action = params.get('action', [''])[0]
        
        state = DrillHandler.state
        
        if action == 'Reveal' and state and not state.ended:
            state.reveal()
        elif action in ('Forgot', 'Hard', 'Good', 'Easy') and state and not state.ended:
            state.grade_card(action.lower())
        elif action == 'Undo' and state and not state.ended:
            state.undo()
        elif action == 'End':
            if state and not state.ended:
                _, started_at, ended_at = state.end_session()
                DrillHandler.finished_html = render_finished_page(state, started_at, ended_at)
                DrillHandler.state = None
        elif action == 'Shutdown':
            if DrillHandler.shutdown_event:
                DrillHandler.shutdown_event.set()
            self.send_response(303)
            self.send_header('Location', '/')
            self.send_header('Content-Length', '0')
            self.end_headers()
            return
        
        self.send_response(303)
        self.send_header('Location', '/')
        self.send_header('Content-Length', '0')
        self.end_headers()

    db_path = get_db_path(directory)
    if os.path.exists(db_path):
        conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        cursor.execute('SELECT card_hash FROM cards')
        db_hashes = set(r[0] for r in cursor.fetchall())
        conn.close()
        # Note: we don't report orphans, just check integrity
    
    print("ok")


def cmd_stats(directory, fmt='html'):
    cards = collect_cards(directory)
    macros = collect_macros(directory)
    
    db_path = get_db_path(directory)
    db_count = 0
    reviewed_today = 0
    
    if os.path.exists(db_path):
        conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        cursor.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards')
        db_count = cursor.fetchone()[0]
        today = date.today().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
        cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT card_hash) FROM reviews WHERE reviewed_at LIKE ?",
                      (today + '%',))
        reviewed_today = cursor.fetchone()[0]
        conn.close()
    
    if fmt == 'json':
        data = {
            'cardsInDeckCount': len(cards),
            'cardsInDbCount': db_count,
            'texMacroCount': len(macros),
            'cardsReviewedTodayCount': reviewed_today
        }
        print(json.dumps(data, indent=2))
    else:
        print("HTML output is not implemented yet.")


def cmd_orphans_list(directory):
    cards = collect_cards(directory)
    card_hashes = set(c['hash'] for c in cards)
    db_path = get_db_path(directory)
    if not os.path.exists(db_path):
        return
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute('SELECT card_hash FROM cards')
    db_hashes = set(r[0] for r in cursor.fetchall())
    conn.close()
    for h in sorted(db_hashes - card_hashes):
        print(h)


def cmd_orphans_delete(directory):
    cards = collect_cards(directory)
    card_hashes = set(c['hash'] for c in cards)
    db_path = get_db_path(directory)
    if not os.path.exists(db_path):
        return
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute('SELECT card_hash FROM cards')
    db_hashes = set(r[0] for r in cursor.fetchall())
    orphans = db_hashes - card_hashes
    for h in orphans:
        cursor.execute('DELETE FROM cards WHERE card_hash = ?', (h,))
        cursor.execute('DELETE FROM reviews WHERE card_hash = ?', (h,))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()


def cmd_export(directory, output=None):
    cards = collect_cards(directory)
    
    db_path = get_db_path(directory)
    performances = {}
    sessions_data = []
    
    if os.path.exists(db_path):
        conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        
        cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM cards WHERE review_count > 0')
        for row in cursor.fetchall():
            h, added_at, last_reviewed_at, stability, difficulty, interval_raw, interval_days, due_date, review_count = row
            performances[h] = {
                'lastReviewedAt': last_reviewed_at,
                'stability': stability,
                'difficulty': difficulty,
                'intervalRaw': interval_raw,
                'intervalDays': interval_days,
                'dueDate': due_date,
                'reviewCount': review_count
            }
        
        cursor.execute('SELECT session_id, started_at, ended_at FROM sessions ORDER BY session_id')
        for sess_row in cursor.fetchall():
            session_id, started_at, ended_at = sess_row
            cursor2 = conn.cursor()
            cursor2.execute('SELECT * FROM reviews WHERE session_id = ? ORDER BY review_id', (session_id,))
            reviews = []
            for rrow in cursor2.fetchall():
                review_id, sid, card_hash, reviewed_at, grade, stability, difficulty, interval_raw, interval_days, due_date = rrow
                reviews.append({
                    'reviewId': review_id,
                    'sessionId': sid,
                    'cardHash': card_hash,
                    'reviewedAt': reviewed_at,
                    'grade': grade,
                    'stability': stability,
                    'difficulty': difficulty,
                    'intervalRaw': interval_raw,
                    'intervalDays': interval_days,
                    'dueDate': due_date
                })
            sessions_data.append({
                'sessionId': session_id,
                'startedAt': started_at,
                'endedAt': ended_at,
                'reviews': reviews
            })
        conn.close()
    
    for card in cards:
        if card['hash'] in performances:
            card['performance'] = performances[card['hash']]
    
    cards.sort(key=lambda c: c['hash'])
    
    data = {'cards': cards, 'sessions': sessions_data}
    result = json.dumps(data, indent=2)
    
    if output:
        with open(output, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            f.write(result)
    else:
        print(result)


def cmd_drill(directory, host='127.0.0.1', port=8000, card_limit=None,
              new_card_limit=None, from_deck=None, open_browser=True,
              answer_controls='full', bury_siblings=True):
    conn = init_db(directory)
    all_cards = collect_cards(directory)
    
    if from_deck:
        all_cards = [c for c in all_cards if c['deckName'] == from_deck]
    
    sync_cards_to_db(conn, all_cards)
    card_map = {c['hash']: c for c in all_cards}
    
    today = date.today().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    # New cards
    cursor.execute('''SELECT card_hash FROM cards WHERE review_count = 0 ORDER BY added_at''')
    new_hashes = [r[0] for r in cursor.fetchall() if r[0] in card_map]
    
    # Due cards
    cursor.execute('''SELECT card_hash FROM cards WHERE review_count > 0 AND due_date <= ? ORDER BY due_date ASC''',
                  (today,))
    due_hashes = [r[0] for r in cursor.fetchall() if r[0] in card_map]
    
    if new_card_limit is not None:
        new_hashes = new_hashes[:new_card_limit]
    
    all_due = due_hashes + new_hashes
    
    if card_limit is not None:
        all_due = all_due[:card_limit]
    
    macros = collect_macros(directory)
    
    # Set up handler class state
    DrillHandler.state = DrillState(all_due, card_map, conn,
                                     answer_controls=answer_controls,
                                     bury_siblings=bury_siblings)
    DrillHandler.finished_html = None
    DrillHandler.macros = macros
    DrillHandler.deck_dir = directory
    DrillHandler.resource_dir = _RESOURCE_DIR
    
    shutdown_event = threading.Event()
    DrillHandler.shutdown_event = shutdown_event
    
    httpd = HTTPServer((host, port), DrillHandler)
    
    def serve():
        while not shutdown_event.is_set():
            httpd.handle_request()
        httpd.server_close()
    
    t = threading.Thread(target=serve, daemon=True)
    t.start()
    
    print(f"Serving on http://{host}:{port}/")
    
    if open_browser:
        threading.Timer(0.5, lambda: webbrowser.open(f'http://{host}:{port}/')).start()
    
    shutdown_event.wait()
    conn.close()


# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog='hashcards',
        description='A plain text-based spaced repetition system.'
    )
    parser.add_argument('--version', action='version', version='hashcards 0.3.0')
    
    subs = parser.add_subparsers(dest='command')
    
    # drill
    drill = subs.add_parser('drill', help='Drill cards through a web interface')
    drill.add_argument('directory', nargs='?', default='.',
                       help='Path to the collection directory. By default, the current working directory is used')
    drill.add_argument('--card-limit', type=int, default=None,
                       help='Maximum number of cards to drill in a session. By default, all cards due today are drilled')
    drill.add_argument('--new-card-limit', type=int, default=None,
                       help='Maximum number of new cards to drill in a session')
    drill.add_argument('--host', default='127.0.0.1',
                       help='The host address to bind to. Default is 127.0.0.1')
    drill.add_argument('--port', type=int, default=8000,
                       help='The port to use for the web server. Default is 8000')
    drill.add_argument('--from-deck', default=None,
                       help='Only drill cards from this deck')
    drill.add_argument('--open-browser', default='true', choices=['true', 'false'],
                       help='Whether to open the browser automatically. Default is true')
    drill.add_argument('--answer-controls', default='full', choices=['full', 'binary'],
                       help='Which answer controls to show')
    drill.add_argument('--bury-siblings', default='true', choices=['true', 'false'],
                       help='Whether or not to bury siblings. Default is true')
    
    # check
    check = subs.add_parser('check', help='Check the integrity of a collection')
    check.add_argument('directory', nargs='?', default='.',
                       help='Path to the collection directory. By default, the current working directory is used')
    
    # stats
    stats = subs.add_parser('stats', help='Print collection statistics')
    stats.add_argument('directory', nargs='?', default='.',
                       help='Path to the collection directory. By default, the current working directory is used')
    stats.add_argument('--format', default='html', choices=['html', 'json'],
                       help='Which output format to use')
    
    # orphans
    orphans = subs.add_parser('orphans', help='Commands relating to orphan cards')
    orphans_subs = orphans.add_subparsers(dest='orphans_command')
    ol = orphans_subs.add_parser('list', help='List the hashes of all orphan cards in the collection')
    ol.add_argument('directory', nargs='?', default='.')
    od = orphans_subs.add_parser('delete', help='Remove all orphan cards from the database')
    od.add_argument('directory', nargs='?', default='.')
    
    # export
    export = subs.add_parser('export', help='Export a collection')
    export.add_argument('directory', nargs='?', default='.',
                        help='Path to the collection directory. By default, the current working directory is used')
    export.add_argument('--output', default=None,
                        help='Optional path to the output file. By default, the output is printed to stdout')
    
    args = parser.parse_args()
    
    if args.command == 'drill':
        cmd_drill(
            directory=os.path.abspath(args.directory),
            host=args.host,
            port=args.port,
            card_limit=args.card_limit,
            new_card_limit=args.new_card_limit,
            from_deck=args.from_deck,
            open_browser=(args.open_browser == 'true'),
            answer_controls=args.answer_controls,
            bury_siblings=(args.bury_siblings == 'true')
        )
    elif args.command == 'check':
        cmd_check(os.path.abspath(args.directory))
    elif args.command == 'stats':
        cmd_stats(os.path.abspath(args.directory), fmt=args.format)
    elif args.command == 'orphans':
        if args.orphans_command == 'list':
            cmd_orphans_list(os.path.abspath(args.directory))
        elif args.orphans_command == 'delete':
            cmd_orphans_delete(os.path.abspath(args.directory))
        else:
            orphans.print_help()
    elif args.command == 'export':
        cmd_export(os.path.abspath(args.directory), output=args.output)
    else:
        parser.print_help()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

# When git is checked out fresh, the executable won't be there.
# So compile.sh just needs to CREATE a new executable at ./executable.
# The constraint "cannot overwrite" only applies RIGHT NOW because root owns it.
# When checking out fresh, there's no executable file to overwrite.

# Let me update compile.sh to create the executable properly:
cat > /workspace/compile.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Compile/setup script for hashcards reimplementation
set -e

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"

# Python 3 is required (no other dependencies)
if ! command -v python3 &> /dev/null; then
    echo "Error: python3 is required but not found"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Python version: $(python3 --version)"

# Create the executable
cat > "$SCRIPT_DIR/executable" << 'EXEC_CONTENT'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import sys
import os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), 'src'))
from hashcards import main
main()
EXEC_CONTENT

chmod +x "$SCRIPT_DIR/executable"

echo "Build complete: ./executable is ready"
EOF
chmod +x /workspace/compile.sh

# Test compile.sh on a clean temp directory:
mkdir -p /tmp/test_build

"
